notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has power 5 or greater, does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Declare Crystalline Crawler as an attacker, along with any number of Warrior(s) if desired.
If you declared one or more Warrior(s) as attackers, Najeela triggers, creating that many 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Crystalline Crawler.
Quilled Greatwurm triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
